title: Slip-budget fault-tip continuation cones (deterministic, catalogue-only)
lane_assignment_note: The 2026-10-21 brief contained no identifiable single assigned method paragraph, so this session declares one new narrow lane here before Exp 1 (logged as IR-81-01). It does not re-tune any stopped lane (H77/H77L/H78/H77D/H77-Step/H77E/LIA/contact-physics/XSEN/H79-BB/H79-RH/D77/selective-U).

trace_segments.provenance: owner mirror, pinned at fetch 2026-10-21; NOT organizer-authenticated; grid-checked on use (all vertices inside EPSG:32611 footprint bounds or flagged)

inputs.catalogue_mask_only: existing_faults.tif (SHA-pinned via registry/data_manifest.json; used ONLY as an exact mask, never as a ranking feature)
inputs.sensitivity_only: external/topo_10m_derived_100m_u8.tif bands hs_lineament + curv_prof_absmax (owner mirror of USGS 3DEP 1/3 arc-second derivation; rank gate only, one arm)

fixed_transform.record_chaining: group segments by record_id; chain by shared endpoints within 1 m; keep longest chain; tips = its two end vertices (record-level, not segment joints)
fixed_transform.end_tangent: vector from vertex max(0,n-5) to end vertex, normalized; cone opens outward (away from record interior)
fixed_transform.tip_slip: max slip_mm_yr over record segments; weight = average rank / (n_tips-1) over usable tips (0..1)
fixed_transform.cone: half-angle 30 deg, length 20 px (2.0 km), linear decay (1 - d/20); pixel value = max over tips of weight*decay, float32
fixed_transform.loco_record_rule: a record is usable iff NO vertex lies within 5 px (500 m) of any hidden-truth pixel (fold hidden_all union) AND both tips lie >= 10 px inside the footprint (map-edge cut-end guard)
fixed_transform.surface_scope: one globally LOCO-safe surface per experiment (tips usable under all folds), so no hidden component informs any fold

surfaces.slip_cone_primary: slip-weighted cones from all-sense usable tips
surfaces.tip_uniform: identical cones with weight = 1 (isolates the slip budget)
surfaces.normal_only: slip-weighted cones from usable tips whose record modal sense == N (isolates kinematics)
surfaces.scarp_gated: slip_cone_primary * rank01(hs_lineament + curv_prof_absmax) on footprint (single corroboration sensitivity)

folds.comparability: same fold construction as H77-Step best (0.152718) and H79-RH (0.04773): 11,321 withheld positives expected

emission.method: greedy min-separation 3.0 px Euclidean (src/gems77lia/allocate.greedy_select) over allowed = footprint & ~masked_known & (surface > 0)
emission.budget_fallback: if any fold or the full-catalogue surface yields fewer than 37654 dots, budget B = floor(min_capacity/100)*100 applied identically to ALL arms; B is reported, never tuned per arm
emission.catalogue_rule: zero positive pixels on mapped catalogue in the final artifact (shared writer enforces)

experiments.name: features + leakage canary + surface uniqueness
steps: per-feature symmetric AUC on hide-and-recover folds (300k negatives/fold max, seed 81)
full-footprint Spearman vs every accessible registry raster + local TIFFs

experiments.name: pooled holdout
experiments.metric: pooled HOLDOUT-DTI via evaluate_holdout.evaluate + pooled_summary (draws=2000, candidate=H81_slip)
experiments.gate: no within-experiment tuning; surfaces frozen from E1

experiments.name: dot emission + final uniqueness + artifact
steps: emit B dots from full-catalogue primary surface
final-dot Spearman + 3px forward/reverse overlap vs registry + locals
shared submission_writer artifact (zeros primary + NaN twin + zip + receipt)
stop_rules: final max |rho| > 0.90 or forward 3px overlap > 0.70 vs ANY raster -> log duplicate, verdict negative, artifact stays research-only

promotion_rule: promote IFF pooled H81_slip HOLDOUT-DTI beats 0.152718 with paired 95% CI excluding 0 AND literal uniqueness passes AND all canaries <= 0.90 AND shared-writer validation passes; otherwise negative. Selector approval is a separate step; this lane spends no weekly slot.

name_note.submission_name: gems77-h81-slipcone-37654dots-20261021-zeros (suffix adjusted to actual B/sha at build)
name_note.note_max_140: reserved; <=140 chars; written at build time from measured numbers only
